title: return_ring
description: Returns a claimed ring to the unclaimed ring pool, with the fate on it (Deduction, Overlooked Community, Severed from the Stream: one message per ring). The contested ring is not returned: it stays the ring of the conflict until the conflict ends; a ring claimed as the conflict resolves is returned once claimed (Henshin Mysteries).

ring.description: Ring to return, in the claimed ring pool of a player.
